message.content: In the conversation, Jake Watson specifically mentions a goal from the 2015 match as being incredibly impressive. He states, "For sure! That goal by Neymar in the 2015 match was just incredible! The way he finished it and sealed our place in the final was epic!" This indicates that Jake considers Neymar's goal from the 2015 match to be the most incredible of the ones he remembers from that particular match.
